Key case facts from White v. Carmichael Industries:
- Plaintiff Ms. White alleges she was unlawfully terminated in retaliation for raising concerns about environmental violations (whistleblower claim).
- Defendant Carmichael Industries argues the termination was due to organizational restructuring and unrelated to the allegations.
- The core legal dispute centers on whether the termination was retaliatory or based on legitimate business restructuring.

The organ that pumps blood is the heart.
